description: One run of the whiteboard application (one part, one square) as PLC I/O, used by the in-browser demo (src/sim/demo.ts) and the MQTT simulator (scripts/simulate.mjs). Follows NewProgram in plc/ProjetoFinalRobotica. Channels: DIn = X20DI9371 channel n, DOn = X20DO9322 channel n; DO2 is LIGA_JAKA (TRUE while a cycle runs), as TwinSender sends it. DI12 (E-stop, TRUE = safe) is always on. Times in seconds. Jaka (about 14 s to the plate on the conveyor), conveyor (about 7 s) and Staubli drawing (about 8 s per square) timed on the cell; other Staubli times are estimates.

events.note: Start: Jaka DI3 (put the plate on the conveyor, on for the whole cycle), LIGA_JAKA and a 1 s Staubli DI13 pulse
End of the Staubli DI13 pulse
Sensor Jaka: plate on the conveyor
Jaka DO7 done (plate released, gripper lifted); PLC starts the conveyor
Sensor Staubli: plate arrived after about 7 s; PLC stops the conveyor, step 2 starts a 1 s Staubli DI12 pulse
End of the Staubli DI12 pulse
Staubli DO4 done (part on the board, robot home)
Staubli clears DO4; PLC sets DI14 (pick the marker and draw)
Staubli DO7: square drawn (about 8 s of drawing)
Staubli DO5 done (marker stored); PLC clears DI14
Staubli clears DO5; cycle counted, PLC clears Ligar, Jaka DI3 and LIGA_JAKA
